CREATE TABLE public.prc_process_work (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    stage text NOT NULL,
    work_key bytea NOT NULL,
    work_identity jsonb NOT NULL,
    work_identity_schema_version smallint NOT NULL,
    intent_id uuid,
    input_revision bigint NOT NULL,
    input_hash bytea NOT NULL,
    input_payload jsonb NOT NULL,
    input_schema_version smallint NOT NULL,
    state text NOT NULL,
    reason_code text,
    due_at timestamp with time zone,
    provider_recovery_due_at timestamp with time zone,
    priority smallint DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
    platform_id bigint,
    cohort_key text NOT NULL,
    origin_run_id uuid,
    crawl_block_id uuid,
    procurement_id bigint,
    document_id bigint,
    document_version_id bigint,
    analysis_window_id uuid,
    analysis_run_id uuid,
    generation bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    owner_token uuid,
    lease_until timestamp with time zone,
    heartbeat_at timestamp with time zone,
    dispatch_generation bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    dispatch_claim_until timestamp with time zone,
    checkpoint jsonb,
    checkpoint_schema_version smallint,
    checkpoint_seq bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    execution_attempts bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    transport_attempts bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    semantic_reasks bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    item_failures integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    infrastructure_interruptions bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    transition_seq bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_admitted_claim_check CHECK (((state = 'admitted'::text) = (dispatch_claim_until IS NOT NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_checkpoint_schema_check CHECK (((checkpoint IS NULL) = (checkpoint_schema_version IS NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_checkpoint_schema_version_check CHECK ((checkpoint_schema_version > 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_checkpoint_seq_check CHECK ((checkpoint_seq >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_deferred_due_check CHECK (((state <> 'deferred'::text) OR (due_at IS NOT NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_dispatch_generation_check CHECK ((dispatch_generation >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_due_state_check CHECK (((due_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'deferred'::text))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_execution_attempts_check CHECK ((execution_attempts >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_generation_check CHECK ((generation >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_infrastructure_interruptions_check CHECK ((infrastructure_interruptions >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_input_hash_check CHECK ((octet_length(input_hash) = 32)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_input_revision_check CHECK ((input_revision >= 1)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_input_schema_version_check CHECK ((input_schema_version > 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_item_failures_check CHECK (((item_failures >= 0) AND (item_failures <= 3))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_owner_check CHECK ((((stage = 'listing'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(crawl_block_id, procurement_id, document_id, document_version_id, analysis_window_id, analysis_run_id) = 1) AND (crawl_block_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = ANY (ARRAY['detail'::text, 'status_refresh'::text])) AND (num_nonnulls(crawl_block_id, procurement_id, document_id, document_version_id, analysis_window_id, analysis_run_id) = 1) AND (procurement_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare'::text, 'screening'::text])) AND (num_nonnulls(crawl_block_id, procurement_id, document_id, document_version_id, analysis_window_id, analysis_run_id) = 1) AND (document_version_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = 'extraction'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(crawl_block_id, procurement_id, document_id, document_version_id, analysis_window_id, analysis_run_id) = 1) AND (analysis_window_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = 'publication'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(crawl_block_id, procurement_id, document_id, document_version_id, analysis_window_id, analysis_run_id) = 1) AND (analysis_run_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = 'download'::text) AND (num_nonnulls(crawl_block_id, procurement_id, document_id, document_version_id, analysis_window_id, analysis_run_id) = 1) AND (document_id IS NOT NULL)))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_provider_recovery_due_check CHECK ((((state = 'blocked'::text) AND (reason_code = 'provider_result_unknown'::text)) = (provider_recovery_due_at IS NOT NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_reason_check CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['deferred'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'failed_item'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'superseded'::text])) OR (reason_code IS NOT NULL))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_running_lease_check CHECK ((((state = 'running'::text) AND (owner_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state <> 'running'::text) AND (owner_token IS NULL) AND (lease_until IS NULL)))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_semantic_reasks_check CHECK ((semantic_reasks >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_stage_check CHECK ((stage = ANY (ARRAY['listing'::text, 'detail'::text, 'status_refresh'::text, 'download'::text, 'prepare'::text, 'screening'::text, 'extraction'::text, 'publication'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['ready'::text, 'admitted'::text, 'running'::text, 'deferred'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed_item'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'superseded'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_transition_seq_check CHECK ((transition_seq >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_transport_attempts_check CHECK ((transport_attempts >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_work_identity_schema_version_check CHECK ((work_identity_schema_version > 0)),
    CONSTRAINT prc_process_work_work_key_check CHECK ((octet_length(work_key) = 32))
)
WITH (fillfactor='75', autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor='0.01', autovacuum_vacuum_threshold='500', autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor='0.02', autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit='2000', autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay='2');

retention.business: Оригиналы, estimates, gold, provenance и справочники: отдельная domain policy; завершение run не разрешает удаление.
retention.authority: Active work/attempt/incident, pending outbox, pinned evidence и referenced artifacts не удаляются. Terminal work_key tombstones бессрочно при unbounded rediscovery/replay.
retention.journal: Transitions/admin audit/financial metadata минимум 365 дней; только после mandatory projection receipts; source pruning атомарно помечает history incomplete.
retention.requests: Successful request details 30 дней; failed/stale 90 дней; dedup identity дольше максимального callback/replay horizon.
retention.incidents: Resolved incidents 180 дней; active/acknowledged incidents и pinned evidence сохраняются.
retention.technical: Technical logs 14 дней; не являются authority.
retention.financial: Unknown requests и их reservations не удаляются; settlement original period; financial metadata минимум 365 дней.
retention.artifacts: Mark + deletion generation под lock, object delete вне tx, CAS finalize. New refs используют общий deletion gate; staged objects живого intent/lease защищены; grace >= max lease + retry horizon.
retention.projection: Receipts обязательных consumers защищают source event; totals не уменьшаются от retention, active generation не удаляется; rebuild после source prune явно unavailable.
retention.runtime: Кеш/queue/session/runtime TTL по framework policy; это не authority business work.
retention.proxyma: По правилам Proxyma. Пакетная очистка после 30 дней удаляет только завершённые записи до авторизации, сохраняя факты отправки и результаты с неопределённым исходом.

listing.fence: head_generation/input_revision; cursor checkpoint не увеличивает head

prepare.fence: document head, immutable version, pinned preparation recipe

extraction.fence: document/version/run/window links, heads, recipe, analysis generation
